score_range_label.zh: 中高确信度 (63.3) — 流动性扩张，广度偏弱

position_advice.en: 63% (Favor tech/industrials/energy. Stop-loss at S&P 7,200. Add to 70% if breadth breaks 55%, cut to 45% if Warsh announces accelerated QT)
position_advice.zh: 63%（偏向科技/工业/能源。止损S&P 7,200。广度突破55%加至70%，Warsh宣布加速缩表降至45%）

summary.en: Liquidity is expanding. Fed balance sheet expanded by $19.0B WoW (strongest in weeks). TGA released $55.3B WoW, down from $1.007T peak. Net liquidity expanded strongly by $70.8B WoW. Bank reserves are back above $3T at $3,117.4B (+$65.9B WoW). Repo lending is low. However, Warsh took office on 5/13 with clear intentions for significant QT, posing a medium-term risk.
summary.zh: 流动性正在扩张。美联储资产负债表周环比扩张 $19.0B（数周来最强）。TGA 释放 $55.3B，从 $1.007T 峰值持续回落。净流动性强劲扩张 $70.8B。银行准备金重返 $3T 以上，达到 $3,117.4B（+$65.9B）。Repo lending 处于低位。然而，Warsh 于 5/13 上任，明确表示要大幅缩表，构成中期风险。

fed_balance_sheet_change.zh: +190 亿美元（周环比）——数周来最强扩张

tga_note.zh: 周环比 -$55.3B——从 $1.007T 峰值持续释放

details.en: Liquidity metrics are highly positive in the short term. The Fed balance sheet expanded by $19B, and the TGA continues to release funds (-$55.3B), injecting cash into the system. Bank reserves have surged back above $3.1T. However, the appointment of Warsh on 5/13 introduces a significant medium-term risk, as he has explicitly stated intentions for substantial quantitative tightening.
details.zh: 短期内流动性指标非常积极。美联储资产负债表扩张了 $19B，TGA 持续释放资金（-$55.3B），向系统注入现金。银行准备金飙升重返 $3.1T 以上。然而，Warsh 于 5/13 的上任引入了重大的中期风险，因为他已明确表示有意进行大幅量化紧缩。

reason.en: Fed expanded balance sheet by $19B, TGA released $55B, and bank reserves returned to $3.1T. However, Warsh's QT intention is a medium-term risk.
reason.zh: 美联储扩表 $19B，TGA 释放 $55B，银行准备金重返 $3.1T。但 Warsh 的缩表意图是中期风险。

reason.en: Q1 growth strongest since 2021. Forward P/E dropped from 22.2 to 21.4 (healthy valuation compression). NTM EPS at $291.65.
reason.zh: Q1 增长为 2021 年以来最强。Forward P/E 从 22.2 降至 21.4（健康的估值压缩）。NTM EPS 为 $291.65。

reason.en: Only 51.29% of stocks above 200DMA. Financials -3.3% YTD, Healthcare -0.6%. Market driven primarily by Energy, Industrials, and Tech.
reason.zh: 仅 51.29% 的股票在 200 日均线上方。金融 YTD -3.3%，医疗 -0.6%。市场主要由能源、工业和科技三大板块驱动。

reason.en: S&P at 7,403, close to ATH of 7,515. VIX low at 17.82. However, the -1.24% drop on 5/15 serves as a warning.
reason.zh: S&P 报 7,403，接近历史新高 7,515。VIX 处于 17.82 的低位。然而，5/15 下跌 -1.24% 是一个警告。

trading_summary.en: 63.3 — Moderate-High. Liquidity says 'go long' — TGA released $200B from $1T peak, Fed expanding +$19B/wk, bank reserves back above $3.1T. Strongest positive signal in 6 weeks. But breadth says 'be careful' — only 51% above 200DMA, market driven by 3 sectors. Warsh is the X-factor. 63% position, favor tech/industrials/energy. Stop-loss at S&P 7,200. Add to 70% if breadth breaks 55%, cut to 45% if Warsh announces accelerated QT.
trading_summary.zh: 63.3分，Moderate-High。流动性在说'做多'——TGA从$1T释放$200B，Fed扩表+$19B/周，银行准备金重返$3.1T。六周来最清晰正面信号。但广度在说'小心'——仅51%在200日均线上方，市场由三板块驱动。Warsh是X因素。63%仓位，偏向科技/工业/能源。止损S&P 7,200。广度突破55%加至70%，Warsh宣布加速缩表降至45%。

trading_quote: Liquidity says 'go long', breadth says 'be careful'. Warsh is the X-factor.

analysis.en: BTC is at $76,221, down 2.30%. It remains 40% below its $126K all-time high, showing a persistent divergence from equities which are near their ATH.
analysis.zh: BTC 报 $76,221，下跌 2.30%。它仍比 $126K 的历史高点低 40%，显示出与接近历史新高的股市持续背离。

analysis.en: Gold is trading at $4,586/oz, maintaining its strength amidst mixed macro signals.
analysis.zh: 黄金交易价格为 $4,586/盎司，在混合的宏观信号中保持强势。

detail.en: Warsh took office on 5/13 with clear intentions for 'significant QT' and 'less intervention'. The June FOMC is a critical juncture. If MBS runoff accelerates or Treasury purchases stop, the current +$19B/week expansion could turn negative, fundamentally deteriorating the liquidity formula.
detail.zh: Warsh 5/13 上任明确要'大幅缩表'和'less intervention'。6 月 FOMC 是关键节点。如果加速 MBS runoff 或停止国债购买，当前 +$19B/周扩表会变负，流动性公式根本性恶化。

detail.en: Only 51.29% of stocks are above their 200DMA, well below the 55% threshold. Financials are down 3.3% YTD and Healthcare is down 0.6%. The -1.24% drop in the S&P on 5/15 was the worst single day since March, wiping out $800B in market cap. The market is fragile at these highs.
detail.zh: 仅 51.29% 在 200 日均线上方，不到 55%。金融 -3.3% YTD 医疗 -0.6%。5/15 S&P -1.24% 是 3 月以来最差单日，$800B 市值蒸发。高位脆弱。

title.zh: 通胀加速 + BTC -40% 背离

detail.en: May CPI/PPI data is bearish, pricing in almost zero probability of rate cuts in 2026. BTC has dropped from $126K to $76K while equities are near ATH, indicating continued internal divergence within risk assets.
detail.zh: CPI/PPI 5 月数据 bearish，2026 年几乎没有降息概率。BTC 从 $126K 跌至 $76K 而股市接近 ATH，风险资产内部分化持续。

title.en: Active. S&P near ATH but breadth weak. Liquidity expanding but Warsh QT looming. Inflation accelerating but no cuts priced in. BTC -40% vs Equity ATH.
title.zh: 活跃。S&P 接近 ATH 但广度仅 51%。流动性在扩张但 Warsh 要缩表。通胀加速但市场 price in no cuts。BTC -40% vs 股市 ATH。

detail.en: S&P is at 7,400 (near ATH) but breadth is only 51%. Liquidity is expanding but Warsh wants to tighten. Inflation is accelerating but the market prices in no cuts. BTC is down 40% versus equities at ATH.
detail.zh: S&P 在 7,400（接近 ATH）但广度仅 51%。流动性在扩张但 Warsh 要缩表。通胀加速但市场 price in no cuts。BTC -40% vs 股市 ATH。
